title: chant merge record
description: What landed on the target branch, keyed by commit: _merges/<commit>.json on chant/lifecycle (#4168, chant 0.124.33 and newer). The record job writes it on merge. It applies nothing; a release that carries the commit deploys it.

base.description: The commit the change is measured from.

member.description: The workspace member whose pipeline wrote it.

source.description: Where the change came from: the pull request that merged it, else the work items its Chant-Record: work:<id> trailers name, else a direct push.

op.description: The pull request's gate op, pr-<n> or pr-<n>-<member>; null without a pull request.

digest.description: The change-set digest planned on the merged commit; null when nothing was planned. The change set is stored under _change-sets/.

plan.description: approved: an approval stands for digest. changed: one stands for approvedDigest, so the plan moved after review; the record job's chant/record status fails. unapproved: none stands. nothing: no component deploys what the change touches. plan-failed: a member failed to plan.

authorApproved.description: Approvers who wrote the change (#4000), read with a forge.
